_comment: The ledges pack's art (content sets GEN-5): SHAPES ONLY, no image file, in the meta theme's recipe format (a 20x20 box, the maze's TILE_PX). Drawn OVER the cell the maze has already painted (the tile-kind overlay). The ledge's only way in is moving SOUTH (its structure entry's dirs), so the art says so at a glance: the rock lip runs along the NORTH edge, where you drop from, and a bold chevron points SOUTH, the way you move onto it. Art is presentation only.

gen5.note: the ledges pack, content sets GEN-5 (Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5). No approval of its names or shapes is recorded

ledges:terrain/ledge.note: a ledge seen from above, dropping south: a brown rock lip along the north edge with a light top line and a dark face below it, a soft shadow under the face, and a bold cream chevron with a dark outline pointing south
